work.description: Mutable institutional web calendar. Date-specific entries are witnesses to this institution’s published calendar and do not independently establish another territory’s local observance. The institution styles itself Fraternité Sacerdotale Saint-Pierre, Province de France: the page title reads 'Ordo du mois - FSSP - Province de France' and its copyright line 'Fraternité Sacerdotale Saint-Pierre, Province de France' in the response read 2026-10-01 (169,634 bytes, not registered, read only to settle the responsible body), and the 2026-09-28 registration recorded the same body in English. The responsible field read 'District de France' until 2026-10-01; that form survives in the publication fields of the 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-22 editions, whose unretained responses were not re-read for it, and is kept only as a search alias, with FSSP France and Priestly Fraternity of Saint Peter, Province of France. IDENTITY: the same page was registered a second time on 2026-09-28 as work.priestly-fraternity-of-saint-peter-france.ordo-du-mois. That identity was retired on 2026-10-01 and its one edition and artifact were merged here as edition.fssp-france.ordo-du-mois.web-2026-09-28 and its artifact, the earlier and more widely bound identity being kept as the stable one; the former identifiers are recorded on those two records.
